$schema: Phase 0 scope manifest (informal JSON; not JSON Schema)
title: Scope, success criteria, and non-goals
primary_input_source: Basic web UI: forms and controls collect preferences and submit a payload matching schemas/user-preferences.schema.json (Phase 2+). Optional REST or CLI may reuse the same contract later.
user_inputs: min_rating (0..5, inclusive filter in later phases)

output.description: Top N recommendations; each with name, cuisine, rating, estimated_cost, ai_rationale; optional comparative_summary.

quality_bar.hard_filters: Final list must satisfy structured filters (location, budget, cuisine overlap policy, min_rating) defined in Phase 3+.
quality_bar.grounding: Every recommendation must map to an allowed restaurant_id from the candidate set; no invented venues.
quality_bar.explanations: ai_rationale must cite alignment with user preferences using attributes present in data.

success_criteria: The basic web UI is the primary input source and submits the same preference shape as golden-queries examples (optional API/CLI may mirror it)
Golden queries document manual evaluation intent for demos and regression checks
non_goals: Live Zomato or third-party restaurant API integration (static Hugging Face dataset only unless explicitly added later)
User accounts, auth, or saved profiles (unless added in a later phase)
Guaranteed global coverage or freshness of restaurant data
